title: fix(cors): reflect request origin when credentials is true with wildcard

expectedFindings.description: With `origin: '*'` and `credentials: true`, the middleware now echoes any request Origin (including `null`) with Allow-Credentials. A config browsers used to reject now lets every site read cookie-authenticated responses.

mustNotSkip.reason: Preflight Vary handling changed to match the reflection.
Response Vary handling changed to match the reflection.

evidence.note: Advisory (high): CORS middleware reflects any Origin with credentials when origin defaults to the wildcard. Patched in 4.12.25.
Security fix: removes exactly the lines #4813 added to findAllowOrigin and both Vary conditions.
